headline: AXA Mansard Reports 81% Rise in Profit to N10.9 Billion
summary: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc reported an 81 percent increase in profit after tax to N10.9 billion, driven by stronger underwriting performance.
why: Corporate earnings reports provide investors with essential visibility into an insurer's underwriting profitability, financial health, and operational performance.
